prints an independent final getter oracle. No Idea plugin is applied by the
shipping bridge, and no imported-name fallback or UI decision is introduced.
Actual Gradle listener ordering and oracle equality still require execution.

formatter, edition 2024. The retained receipt reports formatter and idempotent
check exits of zero. I independently verified before/after file hashes, equality
to prior/current source, ordered function names and string literals, and all 28
unchanged test attributes. I did not run the formatter or any compiler. Full
workspace formatting remains a separate pending gate.

Basic and V2 parsing, Android UI/build consumers, project publication, editor,
physical tree and themes remain unchanged. Their hashes and byte equality are
recorded in `ui-static-current.json`. Raw names and nullable getter failures
still cannot replace the caller's Basic model, and no shipping UI consumes the
